site: Example bench (INRIA Paris Robotics Lab Unitree Go2 simulation driver)
notes: Example only, not a statement about any Unitree Go2 deployment and not a device limit. The pinned simulation package states no numeric bound for motor_cmd q, dq, tau, kp or kd, so the driver declares every one operator_required and refuses every /lowcmd publication with MHS.SAFETY.LIMITS_UNSET until the operator supplies this reviewed per-joint envelope. Replace every value below with the deployment's reviewed joint envelope; the overlay may only narrow the driver's limit.

motor_cmd[*].q.reason: example: replace with the reviewed joint position envelope

motor_cmd[*].dq.reason: example: replace with the reviewed joint velocity envelope

motor_cmd[*].tau.reason: example: replace with the reviewed joint torque envelope

motor_cmd[*].kp.reason: example: replace with the reviewed joint stiffness envelope

motor_cmd[*].kd.reason: example: replace with the reviewed joint damping envelope
